# NHK WORLD

> NHK WORLD's dedicated platform for professional sumo wrestling coverage, featuring tournament highlights, wrestler profiles, and live streaming of Grand Sumo events.

NHK WORLD provides comprehensive English-language coverage of Japan's traditional sumo wrestling sport, including tournament results, wrestler rankings by division, and detailed match analysis for international audiences.

## Key Topics

- GRAND SUMO Highlights
- Sumo Wrestling
- Tournament Coverage
- Yokozuna
- Sekiwake
- Komusubi
- Maegashira
- Wrestler Profiles
- NHK WORLD TV
- Japanese Sports
- Live Streaming
- Sumo Techniques
- March Tournament
- Osaka
- ATAMIFUJI

## Sumo Tournament Coverage

- [GRAND SUMO Highlights](https://www3.nhk.or.jp/nhkworld/en/tv/sumo/): NHK WORLD TV's GRAND SUMO Highlights show featuring tournament coverage and wrestler profiles
